name: 奇丽草
evolution: 奇丽草 → 奇丽叶 Lv.16 → 奇丽花 Lv.32 → 奇丽果
evolutionEn: Qilicao → Qiliye Lv.16 → Qilihua Lv.32 → Qiliguo
description: 头顶着花苞爬着前进，总会朝着太阳光的方向。花苞里面似乎孕育着什么，要是长期照不到太阳，花苞就会萎缩。
descriptionEn: It crawls forward with a flower bud on its head, always facing the direction of sunlight. Something seems to be growing inside the bud; if it cannot get sunlight for a long time, the bud will wither.
